gen-press-start-2p-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra is a plain sans with a prominent x-height, set beneath the pinned-apart, cut-out spacing of Press Start 2P. Ramabhadra's standout trait is that large lowercase, which keeps the retro heading from feeling lonely.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-rambla: Cut-out letters pinned far apart give Press Start 2P its playful, retro swagger. Rambla, a sans whose small letters nearly match its capitals, does the opposite job, keeping text tidy and easy-going.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-recursive: Wide-pinned cut-out letters give Press Start 2P a fun, retro jolt at the top. Recursive, a sans with uniform strokes and a tall mean line, then lets paragraphs flow without hairlines to squint at.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-saira-semi-condens: Press Start 2P brings cut-out letters pinned far apart, a fun retro look with soft fat-and-slim strokes. Saira Semi Condensed, a plain sans, runs each stroke like drawn cable.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-secular-one: Retro fun meets flat, heavy-middled type. Press Start 2P delivers the playful, widely spaced flourish, while Secular One, a plain sans without any stroke contrast, supplies the steady heft.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans reads tight, tall and quietly modern. What stands out most is spacing: Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart while Smooch Sans packs its line until gaps nearly vanish.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-sofia-sans-condens: Approachable and contemporary, Sofia Sans Condensed sketches curves like an unpressed pencil. Press Start 2P's pinned-apart, cut-out letters against that pencil-light line make the sharpest contrast, loud against low-key.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-spline-sans-mono: Cut-out letters pinned far apart, with a faint brushed pressure, make Press Start 2P instantly playful. Spline Sans Mono then reads like code, fixed-width and technical, with bold strokes that never thicken or thin.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-strait: Retro fun with a knowing wink, thanks to Press Start 2P's cut-out letters pinned far apart. Strait, a plain sans with big round bowls, handles the everyday reading gently.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-tiny5: A slight pinch where curves meet straight stems gives Press Start 2P its fun, retro bite. Tiny5, a sans, does the opposite job: its tall body makes ascenders look short and lines stay compact.
